# FileCompressionTool
A tool in C for compressing and decompressing using RLE

## Commands to execute
* Navigate to src directory.
* Execute command g++ for compilation as shown below:
  `src student$ g++ *.c -o fileCompressor`
* Execute the generated fileCompressor.out
  
  `./fileCompressor -c ../test_files/test.txt` for compression
  
  `./fileCompressor -d ../test_files/test.rle` for decompression
